name: Hunter's Exalted Orb
description: Adds Hunter influence and a new Hunter modifier to a rare item
directions: Right click this item then left click a high-level rare item with no influence to apply it. Rare items can have up to six random modifiers.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a high-level rare item with no influence to apply it. Rare items can have up to six random modifiers.
